properties.evidence: This idea carries a real hazard: the brainstorm skill's step 2 forbids running detect-and-ask over brainstormed nodes, because asking a user to firm up what they deliberately left soft teaches them that thinking out loud has a cost. A naive detector IS that. req:detecting-is-not-asking (2026-08-19) answers it by splitting the two acts — detection unconditional, invitation held for a boundary — so the leg can be built without taxing the thinking. Neither node mentioned the other before this edge.
